explication: Sigma is a repository of vendor-agnostic detection, hunting, emerging-threat, compliance, and placeholder rules. Detection engineers and defensive practitioners create or consume rules, which are peer reviewed, packaged, and converted by CLI, web, or studio tooling into SIEM queries. The tree confirms the generic, hunting, and emerging-threat collections; compliance and placeholder directories are documented by the README but absent from the supplied tree, so their paths are left null. No implementation source was provided.
